correctness.rationale: The explicit rectangle update is equivalent to directed sink removal. The mutually exclusive all-zero-row/all-one-column first-step cases yield both triangular recurrences with correct empty-boundary values; their union yields F. Successive nonempty sink batches alternate shores, proving the sharp extremal bounds/counts. Surjective column-word enumeration proves every 2-row coefficient. Standalone independent direct-semantics and polynomial/peeling computation checked 92,314 valuations in 19 dimensions, including all 4x4 grids; infinite correctness rests on the proof.
